notes.title: Introducing 'The Prison' An Entire New Adventure To Explore
notes.content:
[h1]'The Prison'[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43581115/3afd98a183755788f177a006a42764b1fd91eb94.png[/img]
I apologize for the delay in releasing this update, life has been incredibly chaotic, and we've been working on a new game which we will announce soon. We are super excited though to be able to offer new content for MicroCrawl though. We have also been working on fixing a variety of smaller issues mostly limited to small glitches and spelling errors.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43581115/f90bd39b1f3e2deb075d2abdca7df3c14a7ea7cf.png[/img]
